name: Mem0
shortDescription: Memory layer for agents. Open-source, and you can install it yourself.
longDescription: Mem0 stores memory for agents. The open-source library is free to install yourself. The Hobby cloud plan is free, with 10,000 add requests and 1,000 retrieval requests per month. Paid plans start at $19 per month.
pricingNotes: Confirm Mem0 platform free tier on mem0.ai/pricing.
freeTierNotes: 10,000 add requests and 1,000 retrieval requests per month.
bestFor: Adding persistent memory to an agent you already run
Python projects that can install the open-source library
notIdealFor: More than the free Hobby limits of 10,000 adds and 1,000 retrievals a month
strength: Mem0 2.2.1 is the open-source library, and the cloud plan includes 10,000 add requests and 1,000 retrieval requests per month.
weakness: The paid plan starts at $19 per month once you pass those monthly request limits.

handsOn.detail: We installed version 2.2.1 and confirmed it loads. We did not sign up, pay, or run it on a real task.

useCaseFit.research-rag: Stores memory an agent can read later, and we imported the Python package locally.
